payload.description_html: Kank is an unenlagiid theropod dinosaur that grew to around 2 meters in total body length. Like all unenlagiids, it was feathered, long-legged, with a longer snout than its close dromaeosaur relatives. Its discovery bridges the geographic gap of unenlagiid dinosaurs between South America and Antarctica.
